headline: Hopper prices climb: H100 SXM index up +16% and H200 up +11% over 7 days.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index is $5.00 after a +16% 7-day move, and it carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +147% ($10.68 vs $4.32 neocloud).
H200's index rose +11% to $6.00, with hyperscalers at $10.30 versus $5.40 at neoclouds, a +91% premium.
B200 was nearly flat at +1% with a $8.55 index, and RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $5.98, or $3.80 per PFLOP-hour.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour and was flat at +0%, but only 5 providers list it, and its marketplace median is $0.50.
A100 80GB SXM ($2.70) and L40S ($1.50) were flat at +0%, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.07 and $0.66 respectively.
watch: Whether the H100 SXM (+16%) and H200 (+11%) gains spill over into B200, which has moved only +1% so far.
